rows.passes_when: The local hero object, its actor and its 241-joint rig are readable for the settle period.
The mirrored double exists, is activated and has at least one suit part.
rows.fails_when: Spawn returned nothing, activation did not stick, or no suit part appeared within 20 seconds.

rows.passes_when: Poses went through encode and decode and were written to the live double for 300 frames, and the game kept each written pose until the next frame.
rows.fails_when: The double vanished, or the game overwrote its pose between frames.

rows.passes_when: The session is listening and the join address line is in melty.log, or a join completed.
